# Lua — game scripting, metatables, coroutines

Curated by Skill Harbor — @mindrally's expert Lua skill: write idiomatic, high-performance Lua for embedded scripting and games. Covers metatables and metamethods (operator overloading, `__index`/`__newindex` fallback chains), coroutine-based pipelines for cooperative multitasking, closures and the module pattern (`local M = {}`), functional helpers, performance patterns (preallocate tables with known sizes, avoid string concatenation in loops, cache table lookups, use `ipairs` for arrays), common pitfalls (1-based indexing, `nil` semantics, global pollution, `pcall` error handling), and a code-review checklist (idiom correctness, performance hotspots, error paths). Honest caveats: guidance only — the agent needs a Lua codebase (game, embedded script host) to apply it to; the repo contains nothing but this skill (nothing else to audit in the source). Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
